question: Analyze the past performance of all the asset types, stock, commodity, real estate, forex and propose which type of asset is worth to invest in based on investors' risk apetite
query: SELECT   CASE     WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN UNNEST(ARRAY[('stock', 'stock_index'), ('commodity', 'crude_oil_price'), ('real_estate', 'real_estate_index'), ('forex', 'forex_usd_eur')])).1 = 'stock' THEN 1     ELSE 0   END AS stock_risk,   MAX(CASE WHEN UNNEST(ARRAY[('stock', 'stock_index'), ('commodity', 'crude_oil_price'), ('real_estate', 'real_estate_index'), ('forex', 'forex_usd_eur')])).1 = 'commodity' THEN 1   ELSE 0   END AS commodity_risk,   MAX(CASE WHEN UNNEST(ARRAY[('stock', 'stock_index'), ('commodity', 'crude_oil_price'), ('real_estate', 'real_estate_index'), ('forex', 'forex_usd_eur')])).1 = 'real_estate' THEN 1   ELSE 0   END AS real_estate_risk,   MAX(CASE WHEN UNNEST(ARRAY[('stock', 'stock_index'), ('commodity', 'crude_oil_price'), ('real_estate', 'real_estate_index'), ('forex', 'forex_usd_eur')])).1 = 'forex' THEN 1   ELSE 0   END AS forex_risk FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50;
